name: data-table-page
title: Data table page
description: An orders view: title, search toolbar, data table with status badges, prev/next paging, and an empty state.

standards.purpose: Work through a list of records with search and paging.
useWhen: A view lists more records than fit one screen.
doNotUseWhen: Fewer than five records exist — a list without paging is calmer.

rules.check: The toolbar carries a labeled search field; paging controls announce the visible range.
Zero rows render the empty state (what it is + the one action that fills it), never a bare table.
